turns.replyTail: Could you please provide your order number, along with the email address and phone number used for your purchase? This information will allow me to locate your order and provide you with tracking details. 🙂

turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Generally, our orders are shipped within 24 to 48 business hours. Once the package is handed over to the carrier, you will automatically receive an email containing your tracking number.

So that I can check the current status of your order and provide you with precise information, could you please provide your order number as well as the email address and phone number used during your purchase? 🙂

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
